get.description:
The trace, its scores and a light span tree (``TraceDetail``). Inputs and outputs are cut
to ``preview`` characters, less on big pages (all previews of a page share a budget; the
response says how many characters each got); get one full span from ``.../spans/{span_id}``.
With ``full=1`` every span comes in full instead (``TraceDetailFull``).

next_before.description: Pass as ``before`` for the next (older) page.

template.title: Template
template.description: A string (text prompts) or a list of messages.

input.title: Input

ExperimentRunRequest.description: Run a prompt version (or an inline template) with a model over a dataset, in the worker.

label.title: Label
label.description: The score config to compare against.

JudgeReportRequest.title: JudgeReportRequest
JudgeReportRequest.description: Run a judge over a queue's human labels and store a reliability report (in the worker).

cache_hit_rate.title: Cache Hit Rate
cache_hit_rate.description: Cached input tokens / input tokens; null without input tokens.

OtlpAccepted.title: OtlpAccepted
OtlpAccepted.description: Empty object: the JSON form of OTLP's ``ExportTraceServiceResponse``.

redactions.title: Redactions
redactions.description: Values redacted at ingestion (server and SDK).

overlap_s.title: Overlap S
overlap_s.description: How long the old key keeps working (default 1 day).

ScorerSummary.title: ScorerSummary
ScorerSummary.description: ``mean`` and ``ci`` are absent when nothing was scored.

redact_mode.title: Redact Mode
redact_mode.description: PII redaction at ingestion: off, secrets (keys, tokens, cards, IBANs, passwords) or strict (also emails, phone numbers and IP addresses).

SettingsUpdate.title: SettingsUpdate
SettingsUpdate.description: Fields left out keep their current value; ``null`` clears one.

Span.title: Span
Span.description: One unit of work. ``start``/``end`` are Unix seconds.

SpanIn.description: A span as sent by SDKs; only ``trace_id``, ``span_id`` and ``name`` are required.
SpanIn.title: SpanIn

SpanSummary.title: SpanSummary
SpanSummary.description:
A span in the light trace view: structure, timings, tokens, cost and short previews.
``*_preview`` is the start of the input or output (strings as text, anything else as JSON
text); fetch the full span from ``GET .../traces/{trace_id}/spans/{span_id}``.

Trace.title: Trace
Trace.description: Summary of one trace (aggregated over its spans).

preview.title: Preview
preview.description: Characters of input and output preview each span got

TraceDetail.title: TraceDetail
TraceDetail.description:
A trace with a light span tree (one page of spans, oldest first). ``omitted`` spans of
the trace come after this page; ask for them with ``offset=next_offset``.

TraceDetailFull.title: TraceDetailFull
TraceDetailFull.description: The trace with every span in full (``?full=1``; the shape before the light view).

TraceHead.title: TraceHead
TraceHead.description: A trace summary without the root's input and output (see the root span's previews).
